subject.title: Mobile localization misses Wear resources and typed failures

question: Should this active maintainer-owned native localization audit be routed to its planned coordinated repair now, or should the reporter first attach the current verifier/artifact output that identifies the exact missing Wear and Apple entries?
rationale: The issue is newly filed by a repository member and protected with the `maintainer` label; its intended ownership and validation sequencing should not be inferred by automated cleanup.

options.title: Route coordinated repair
options.body: Assign the native-mobile owner to implement and validate the reported source-inventory, typed-state, and generated-artifact corrections together.

options.title: Request audit output first
options.body: Keep the issue as the tracking item while requesting redacted verifier and artifact-diff output that narrows the exact missing entries before implementation.

recommendation.title: Route coordinated repair
recommendation.body: Assign the native-mobile owner to implement and validate the reported source-inventory, typed-state, and generated-artifact corrections together.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and self-assigned the issue, indicating direct current ownership of the reported audit.
